purpose: Describe the semantic capability basis of the actually registered ATHENA control-plane operations without making descriptor existence equivalent to exposure or permission.

basis_shape.runtime_identity: observer/provenance coordinate; excluded from basis_digest and not asserted to be a Git commit
basis_shape.basis_digest: sha256 canonical exposed descriptor content plus unclassified negotiated names
basis_shape.descriptors: currently registered + classified negotiated operations only
basis_shape.capability_classes: class -> sorted currently exposed operation names
basis_shape.unclassified: currently registered negotiated operations with no descriptor
basis_shape.dormant_descriptors: descriptor definitions whose operations are not registered/currently exposed

bootstrap_integration.identity_law: OPERATIONAL_BASIS_DIGEST changes independently of prompt/frontier/issue coordinates

derivation: read the actually registered runtime operation-name set
join registered names to descriptor definitions
descriptor without registration remains dormant and cannot create exposure
registered negotiated name without descriptor becomes UNCLASSIFIED
any UNCLASSIFIED negotiated operation yields HOLD_UNCLASSIFIED_CAPABILITY for semantic auto-selection and BOOTSTRAP_HOLD in one-call boot
compute basis_digest from exposed semantic descriptors plus unclassified names; exclude runtime head/source witness
return runtime_identity independently as observer/provenance state
bind basis_digest as an independent bootstrap/refresh address coordinate

promotion_boundary.library_derivation: qualified independently on parent feature head CI #1367
promotion_boundary.public_mcp_tool: implemented read-only on integration feature branch
promotion_boundary.canonical_runtime_promotion: requires fresh exact-head integration CI and anti-stale ancestry check
